mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_kind = 'TENDER'), 0) AS tenderOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(order_kind = 'PERFORMANCE'), 0) AS performanceOrderCount, COUNT(*) AS totalOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_kind = 'TENDER' THEN guarantee_amount END), 0) AS tenderGuaranteeAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_kind = 'PERFORMANCE' THEN guarantee_amount END), 0) AS performanceGuaranteeAmount, COALESCE(SUM(guarantee_amount), 0) AS totalGuaranteeAmount, COALESCE(SUM(premium_amount), 0) AS totalPremiumAmount, MIN(apply_date) AS dataStartDate, MAX(apply_date) AS dataEndDate FROM ( SELECT 'TENDER' AS order_kind, guarantee_amount, premium_amount, apply_date FROM tender_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'PERFORMANCE' AS order_kind, guarantee_amount, premium_amount, apply_date FROM performance_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) merged

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT enterprise_id FROM tender_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT enterprise_id FROM performance_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) e) AS enterpriseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT project_id FROM tender_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 UNION SELECT project_id FROM performance_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 ) p) AS projectCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_org WHERE is_deleted = 0) AS orgCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tender_order WHERE status = 'EFFECTIVE' AND is_deleted = 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM performance_order WHERE status = 'EFFECTIVE' AND is_deleted = 0) AS effectiveOrderCount
